summary.root_cause_text: Ops changed payment_provider_url from internal://payments-v1 to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration); with v2, orders were marked processed without payment being recorded. Order worker got stuck (heartbeat age rising, processed flat at 36) so the queue backed up; this was cleared by a restart. The deeper cause of the stall is not determined.
recommended: Ask the ops/payments team to validate the payments-v2 provider before retrying the migration.
